# TLS backend

The project's current recorded decision is to use rustls as the TLS backend, chosen for a cleaner and simpler implementation of the transport-security layer. This sits alongside the recorded HTTPS-everywhere policy, under which all communication, internal and external, uses HTTPS with no plaintext HTTP exceptions.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-backend.md
